1.Text: Earn points by completing daily guild quests and personal repeatable quests.

2.Text: Accumulating a certain number of points allows you to open personal chests. Once you join a guild, you can also open guild chests together with other members. Chests reset daily.

3.Text: Daily rankings of guild points will determine the number of rewards for all guild members as well as the grand prize for the event.
